top.name: Power
top.tip: Power. Off is an exact bypass: the sound passes untouched.

top.name: Save
top.tip: Save the current settings and the three envelopes as your own preset (opens the preset box under the plugin).

top.name: Info bubbles (i)
top.tip: Turn these hover tips on or off.

items.name: Multiband
items.tip: Multiband on: three bands with their own envelopes. Off: one envelope for everything (the middle lane).

items.name: Slope (12, 24, 48 dB per octave)
items.tip: How steep the split between the bands is, in dB per octave.

items.name: Low amount
items.tip: How much of the low band envelope is applied. 0 % leaves that band alone.

items.name: Solo
items.tip: Solo: listen to this band only.

items.name: Mid amount
items.tip: How much of the mid band envelope is applied. 0 % leaves that band alone.

items.name: Solo
items.tip: Solo: listen to this band only.

items.name: High amount
items.tip: How much of the high band envelope is applied. 0 % leaves that band alone.

items.name: Solo
items.tip: Solo: listen to this band only.

items.name: Envelopes Linked or Unlinked
items.tip: Linked: all three bands use the same envelope, edit one and all follow.

items.name: Linear phase
items.tip: Linear phase split: no phase shift between the bands. Adds latency (your host compensates) and a softer low crossover.

items.name: Sidechain display
items.tip: What the dashed spectrum line shows: the input, the sidechain, or both.

items.name: Sidechain triggers envelope
items.tip: Hits on the sidechain input restart the envelope (pick a sidechain sound in the bar above).

items.name: Tool: select and move
items.tip: Select and move points.

items.name: Tool: ramp up
items.tip: Draw a ramp up: drag across the lane.

items.name: Tool: ramp down
items.tip: Draw a ramp down: drag across the lane.

items.name: Tool: hold
items.tip: Draw a flat hold: drag across the lane.

items.name: Tool: step
items.tip: Draw a step: hold the level, then jump.

items.name: Tool: delete or reset lane
items.tip: Delete the selected points (nothing selected: reset the lane).

items.name: Tool: select all
items.tip: Select all points in the lane.

items.name: Tool: move left
items.tip: Move the selection (or the whole lane) one grid step left.

items.name: Tool: move right
items.tip: Move the selection (or the whole lane) one grid step right.

items.name: Snap
items.tip: Points snap to the grid while you drag (hold Ctrl to move freely). Click to switch.

items.name: Grid
items.tip: Grid size for editing. Click to change.

items.name: Swing
items.tip: Delays the second half of each cycle for a swung feel. Drag up or down.

items.name: Shape buttons and More
items.tip: Quick shapes for the selected lane. More has trance gates, tremolo, random steps and tools.

items.name: Spectrum or Level view
items.tip: Spectrum: the sound by frequency, dashed before the ducking and filled after. Level: peak level of each band.

items.name: AMOUNT
items.tip: AMOUNT: how deep the envelopes cut. 0 % is an exact bypass, 100 % is the full depth you drew.

items.name: Speed slower
items.tip: Slower.

items.name: Speed (note length)
items.tip: How fast the envelope repeats: a note length in Sync mode, or Hz.

items.name: Speed faster
items.tip: Faster.

items.name: Speed in Hz (only when Sync is off)
items.tip: Speed in cycles per second when Sync is off. Drag up or down.

items.name: Sync or Hz
items.tip: Sync follows the host tempo (150 BPM here). Hz runs at a fixed speed.

items.name: Trigger
items.tip: Repeat: loops with the tempo. Input hit: every loud hit restarts the envelope (no tempo needed).

items.name: Hit threshold (only for Input hit)
items.tip: How loud a hit must be to restart the envelope. Drag up or down.

items.name: Lock
items.tip: Lock the envelopes so a stray click cannot change them.

items.name: Drive
items.tip: Smooth saturation before the ducking (oversampled). The level stays about the same, the sound gets thicker. Drag up or down.

items.name: Drive type
items.tip: Drive character: Tube is warm, Tape is gentle, Soft is round.

items.name: Limiter on
items.tip: Lookahead limiter after the ducking.

items.name: Limit ceiling
items.tip: Highest level the limiter lets through. Drag up or down.

items.name: Smooth
items.tip: Rounds the envelope edges so steps do not click. Drag up or down.

items.name: Offset
items.tip: Moves the envelope later (+) or earlier (-) so the pump lines up with your kick.

items.name: Offset unit
items.tip: Offset in milliseconds or in samples.
